title: Open credit memo larger than the invoice -- payable floors at zero
rationale_key_facts: The invoice itself is a clean three-way match at $1,522.20.
Open credit memo CM-2026-021 is for $2,000.00, more than the invoice.
Clause 9 nets it and floors the result at $0.00; a negative payable is never produced.
Netting is explicitly not a defect, so this is an APPROVE at $0.00 rather than a hold. The $477.80 of unused credit stays open.
